info.title: CampusFix implementation contract
info.description: Complete staged design contract. Implementation is staged; consult x-implemented and x-implementation-status on each operation plus PROGRESS.md. x-release identifies R1 hackathon, R2 campus pilot, R3 community. No business behavior should be inferred from this document as already implemented. All requests are JSON <=64KB. Server derives actor from verified Cognito identity; body IDs identify targets only. Application roles/ACLs are authoritative database state.

bearerAuth.description: Cognito access token (token_use=access), approved issuer/client, expiry and campusfix/api scope. Server fetches current active campus membership.

operatorBearer.description: Separately configured operator issuer/client/audience with MFA and explicit operator grant. Never accept a campus ADMIN grant as operator authority.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique per logical mutation. Scope by actor+campus+method+path; retain result at least 24h. Same key/payload replays response; different payload returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Retry only with original key. Non-campus identity/onboarding mutations use a reserved GLOBAL scope, not an invented campus membership.

StandardError.description: Stable safe error. 404 hides inaccessible objects; 403 means forbidden action on visible object; 409 is version/idempotency conflict; 422 includes INVALID_TRANSITION. 429 includes Retry-After.

id.description: Opaque verified Cognito subject; not restricted to RFC UUID.
Opaque verified Cognito subject; not restricted to RFC UUID.

AssignmentChange.description: Unit lead assigns initial owner only; changing existing accountable ownership uses propose-transfer/accept-transfer. A general admin has no implicit sensitive-case authority.

UploadFields.description: Opaque, case-sensitive form fields returned by AWS signing. Send every key/value unchanged; append the file last. Field names include mixed-case X-Amz-* and Policy.

NotificationRead.description: Own records only. allBefore uses a server-provided timestamp from the current page.

AiSource.description: id is the authorized source issue ID; date is the current reviewedAt timestamp. suggestedActions.sourceIds must reference returned source IDs.

MetricBucket.description: Suppressed sensitive buckets omit all counts/sample size and timing values. No revealing drilldown for cohorts under 10.
